1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening exposes a solder mask layer; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure through __at least one of a dielectric material or a conductive bonding agent__.

2. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a bottom surface of the opening __and extends into a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer__.

3. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening __and is in contact with a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure__.

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __by a height greater than a thickness of the solder mask layer__.

5. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer.

6. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer.

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, wherein the stiffening microstructure is positioned to increase contact area and improve package coplanarity.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes__ a lid __having a thickness greater than the solder mask layer thickness__.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, wherein the heat transfer medium is disposed within the opening.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __disposed around a perimeter of the chip mounting surface and bonded to the packaging structure through an opening in the solder mask layer__.

11. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the ground reference plane layer is in contact with the stiffening microstructure __through the opening in the solder mask layer__.

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening exposes a solder mask layer; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure __through at least one of a dielectric material or a conductive bonding agent, wherein the stiffening microstructure is configured to increase lid or ring thickness and contact area to improve package coplanarity__.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening __and extends into a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer__.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __by a height greater than a thickness of the solder mask layer__.

17. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer.

18. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is __selected from the group consisting of__ a ring __or__ a lid __having a thickness greater than the solder mask layer thickness__.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer __through the opening in the solder mask layer__.
